alex: Quick sync - we're kicking off a minimal base-image rebase (minimal-base-v3) this Friday 02:00 UTC. Primary asks: tighten image-builder RBAC, provision new KMS cosign key, ensure audit export (for RBAC and signing) and a vuln triage gate. tagging @jess @liam.

jess: Heads-up: we want to drop any cluster-admin bindings from image-builder SA and replace with a least-privilege role that can push to the artifact repo + write attestation metadata. Plan to use a temp grant pattern during canary.

liam: Agreed on temp grant. Proposed flow:
- create rolebinding image-builder:artifact-writer in staging namespace
- add WorkloadIdentity binding for the pipeline service account
- add a temporary cross-namespace binding TTL=90m for prod canary
- revoke after verification
I'll author a terraform change and include a manual approval step.

priya: KMS notes: create key with label `cosign:base-v3` in staging KMS (HSM-backed). Test sign/verify with cosign, ensure attestations land in the artifact registry. Do not schedule automatic destruction of previous key; keep it for 60 minutes after prod sign-off to allow verification/fallback.

alex: Good. Also: export audit logs for IAM.setIamPolicy and cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersion -> BigQuery table `sec.audit_events` and send a copy to our Splunk index `sec_ops` for realtime monitoring.

jess: Runtime impact: layer reduction will change image digests. SRE: how comfortable with rolling restarts? We should ensure at least one node pool in each region keeps previous image for 10m to serve in-flight requests.

sre-bot: staging job scheduled: 2025-02-07T02:00:00Z. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/minimal-base-rebase (contains rollback steps).

liam: For rolling strategy, suggest this sequence:
1) drain small subset of nodes in prod (label canary=true)
2) deploy new image to canary pods only
3) wait 10m, run synthetic latency/correctness checks
4) if OK, gradually expand; otherwise revert via image tag rollback
Sample commands:
```
kubectl cordon node/canary-1
kubectl drain node/canary-1 --ignore-daemonsets --force --delete-local-data
kubectl set image deploy/inference-runtime inference-runtime=registry.redwood/minimal-base-v3:sha256-abcdef
```

priya: Vulnerability gating: pipeline will run trivy + grype + our internal binary scanner. Block if any HIGH or CRITICAL vuln in runtime packages (openssl, glibc, libseccomp). PR must include `vuln-diff.md` generated by sec-scan-bot.

jess: Also add sbom attach step and cosign attestations. We need an attestation that lists installed packages and applied mitigations.

alex: Incident/backout: if attestations fail or we see >1% error increase in 5m, trigger automatic rollback and alert sec-oncall. Add a quick rollback helper to the runbook: `kubectl set image ... --rollback-to=previous` and how to rebind old KMS key.

sec-scan-bot: trivy scan complete (staging): 0 CRITICAL, 2 HIGH (both in vendor layer) - details in PR #2314. Label: security:investigate.

liam: Thanks bot. I'll hold canary until vendor fixes land or we patch the layer. If vendor patch unavailable, consider thin-override of the package in our layer and rebuild.

priya: Reminder on attestation verification: use `cosign verify-attestation --type application/vnd.cncf.attestation.vuln` and store verification output in `gs://redwood-attestations/minimal-base-v3/`.

jess: Ops ask: add a cache invalidation step for runtime artifacts; our code uses an on-disk package cache keyed by image digest. Quick command to clear caches after rollout:
```
kubectl exec -n prod -l app=inference-runtime -- bash -c "rm -rf /var/cache/inference/* && systemctl restart inference-runtime"
```
Expect warmup period ~3-7m per pod.

alex: Preflight checklist (to add to PR template):
- [ ] terraform PR with temp rolebinding + BigQuery export
- [ ] staging KMS key created + cosign sign/verify success
- [ ] SBOM attached and vulnerability diff in PR
- [ ] runtime cache invalidation steps in runbook
- [ ] synthetic checks + rollback steps documented
- [ ] notify product + sec-oncall for the window

liam: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/5289 (includes terraform plan + approval gate).

jess: :thumbsup: tagging sec-oncall for the window, please stand by for escalation if canary fails.

sec-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll be watching alerts + Splunk dashboard `sec/base-rebase`. If anything odd, I'll join the runbook call.

alex: Thanks everyone. We'll keep updates here during the run. If you hit a blocker, paste logs and cosign outputs into the thread.

sec-scan-bot: Reminder: attach `vuln-diff.md` and `sbom.json` to the final merge commit.
